post.description:
Page presets: 'everyone' opens every page to every role; 'role_menus' limits each role
to its own menu. Start pages and locked pages stay open. One audit entry.

get.description: What the sign-in page shows. Public: reveals only the tenant's display name.

post.description: Pilot-only sign-in by email, for an account IT created. Not available outside dev.
Machine + PIN. Wrong PINs count up; at the limit the login locks until IT enables it.

get.description: Machines with an active station login, for the 'Which station is this?' picker.

schema.title: Response Station Choices Auth Stations Get

delete.description: Undo a correction: the original counts again; the correction stays in the list.

Delete an upload or an import for real. One in use: the plant is rebuilt from the rest
and the answer recalculated; an earlier version it replaced comes back in use.

put.description: The client confirms, changes or skips what a column is (ADR-0011 §3).

post.description: Fix a value or leave a line out; checked by the import's rules, then the plant rebuilds.

get.description: Rebuild the plant without this import in a transaction that is rolled back, and compare.

post.description: Add or replace files. Before the run the upload changes; after it, a new version.

delete.description: Remove a file. Before the run the upload changes; after it, a new version.

post.description:
The client confirms the summary: what each file is and which columns are used. Only
when nothing is left to answer and the three a diagnostic needs are found.

get.description: Rebuild the plant with this upload in a transaction that is rolled back, and compare.
The rows the import's run rejected, with the rule, column and value, and their fixes.

post.description: Start the connector in a worker. The page polls this import until it is done or failed.

put.description:
The client says what a table is, or skips it (ADR-0011 §1: the client confirms). Its
columns are matched again for the role given.

get.description: Progress for ``plant_code``, or for the first plant this role may see.
The plants this role may see: all, or only its own (ADR-0007).

delete.description: Delete a calendar row. One from an upload needs a reason and stays out of rebuilds.

patch.description: Mark a break as covered: someone keeps the machine running during the break.

get.description: Every correction of the plant, newest first; undone ones stay, marked undone.

schema.title: Response List Corrections Plants  Plant Code  Corrections Get

get.description: The corrections as a CSV, to send back to the plant's ERP owner.

delete.description:
Delete every import, file and row of a plant (IT by default, the plant code typed).
The plant itself, its accounts and station logins stay; the history keeps a line per
import.

schema.title: Response Data In Use Plants  Plant Code  Data In Use Get

get.description: The constraint per period from the plant's latest calculation, with every method.

Measured facts of the plant's latest calculation, each a Figure with its provenance.

Filter by ``family`` (repeatable), ``resource_code`` and period: ``period_kind`` ``all``
(the whole data period, default), ``month`` or ``week``; ``period_start_at`` picks one month
or week (see ``/facts/periods``), otherwise every period of that kind is returned.
The periods the plant's facts cover: the whole data period, each month and each week.

schema.title: Response Read Periods Plants  Plant Code  Facts Periods Get

post.description: Store uploaded CSV/Excel exports for a plant. Nothing is read into the platform yet.

put.description: Overtime worked on one machine in one ISO week (never per person).

get.description:
Steps of a plant, with their kind and positions (for pickers and labels; the Plant setup
page manages them).

schema.title: Response List Resources Plants  Plant Code  Resources Get

get.description: Teams shared by several steps (ADR-0009): code, name and steps; never who is in them.

schema.title: Response List Teams Plants  Plant Code  Teams Get
